response.justification: While the candidate demonstrates strong software engineering practices, architectural thinking, and mentoring capabilities, there is a fundamental mismatch with the role's core requirements. The candidate's last significant C++ experience was in 2014-2015; the subsequent 11 years have focused on web/SaaS technologies (TypeScript, Node.js, React). The position requires immediate C++ productivity for high-performance industrial automation systems, IEC 62443 compliance, and industrial protocols—areas not represented in the resume. Substantial ramp-up would be required.
strengths: Strong track record of software craftsmanship with TDD, CI/CD, and clean architecture principles demonstrated across multiple senior roles
Proven experience designing event-driven, distributed systems with message-broker-based architectures and handling performance-critical applications
Demonstrated mentoring capability and leadership in establishing coding standards through workshops and senior technical positions
concerns: 11-year gap in C++ development; current expertise is TypeScript/Node.js, a fundamentally different paradigm unsuitable for core C++ requirements
No background in industrial automation, IoT systems, or industrial cybersecurity; exclusively web/SaaS experience disqualifies for automation machinery domain
No demonstrated knowledge of secure development lifecycle practices, IEC 62443 standards, or industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC standards, DNP 3.0)
